description: This file defines a Dart class 'CartListBloc' that manages a list of 'FoodItem' objects using the BLoC pattern. It provides streams for output and sinks for input to handle adding and removing food items from a shopping cart. It interacts with a provider class to update the list.

classes.name: CartListBloc
classes.description: A BLoC class for managing a list of FoodItem objects in a food delivery app.

methods.name: addToList
methods.description: Adds a FoodItem to the list via the provider and updates the stream.

methods.name: removeFromList
methods.description: Removes a FoodItem from the list via the provider and updates the stream.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the stream controller when the BLoC is disposed.
